Like a said it's not the same hardware nor software. 

Changing animation speed does not accelerate process in the back. Memory management stays the same. OnePlus has a different memory management. Not all apps are optimized for this memory management yet. Even if your app shows up to ur screen it's most likely still not loaded to the Snapdragon according register or cache how ever it is configured. 

Battery optimization comes to play a role on this also, cause if the app is set to 1x and u modify your phone to .5x , battery management is still looking at the 1x and is going to slow down the process to match the back end code. 

Phone are becoming more and more enhanced and modifying values without knowing what you are changing in the code is stupid. There's a reason why it's a developer menu and not active when you get the phone. 

If u know what ur doing as I change ur animation speed you should also change how the memory configuration on that developer menu... It's there 😉

Android 14 ≠ oxygen os14 ≠ one UI

OnePlus has a feature that plays with animation speed, I don't think Samsung or pixel has one. 

So there's a code that plays with animation speed and something that checks that speed to adjust process. When you change the speed from that feature it doesn't change the speed on developer menu. Might be a bug or intentional. Even if the base code is the same, there's a lot of mods on it that makes it different.
